_note: componentExtractionListJobs on the dev instance, 2026-10-12 ~16:45 UTC, before createdBy was exposed. Stage artifacts and model usage dropped to keep it small; nothing else changed.

uncertain.reason: #cacaca (32% share) and #363f54 (near-0% share but visually prominent as footer/section backgrounds in screenshots) are ambiguous — the measurement tool may be counting text/border pixels rather than background fill area, so the mapping of these two to 'sunken surface' vs 'subtle border' is a judgement call, not a confident read.

No distinct link color was identified in the inventory; nav and body links appear to use the same primary text or olive/terracotta accent colors depending on context, so no single confident value could be assigned.
No focus-state color was present in the inventory or screenshots.
No info/success/warning/danger colors appear anywhere in the measured palette; the site has no visible feedback UI in the crawled pages.

Card titles and small eyebrow labels (e.g. 'FLOOR PLANS', 'ANY QUESTIONS?') clearly use a second typeface (gravesend-sans) at smaller sizes, but the exact size/weight pairing was not reliably distinguishable from the aggregated inventory (22px font-size share and 29.6px line-height share didn't cleanly correlate), so these were left unassigned rather than guessed.
No monospace font family was observed anywhere in the inventory.

11.5px is an unusual spacing value (likely a computed/rounded flex-gap rather than an intentional design-scale step); it was kept as-is rather than rounded to a cleaner number like 12px, but this is a judgement call.

Both 15px (10% share) and 16px (27% share) appear close together; 16px was chosen as the representative 'sm' step since it's far more prevalent, but 15px may represent a genuinely distinct step that got collapsed.
No corner radius values were observed in the inventory at all, so no radius tokens were assigned.
No shadows were observed in the inventory; only shadow.none was asserted as a safe default.
Mapped the black header/footer bars to 'sunken' surface for lack of a better slot, but semantically these read more like inverse/dark brand bands than a recessed surface.
Both assigned the same measured #cacaca; unclear whether this light gray is primarily used for muted text, hairline borders, or both — the inventory doesn't distinguish usage context.

Only one corner-radius value (20px) was observed at 100% share, but buttons in the screenshots appear essentially square-cornered at this viewport; unclear which elements (icon buttons, thumbnails?) actually carry this radius.
11.5px is an oddly precise value (possibly a half-pixel artifact of measurement/rounding) rather than a deliberate spacing step; kept as-is but confidence is low.
Only weak evidence (18px at 5% share, paired line-height at 1% share) ties this to a heading rather than a lead/secondary paragraph style.
The brief states the site ships a real dark variant with separately measured colours, but no dark colour list was actually included in the inventory, so no dark tokens could be populated.
Inferred from the 'APPLY NOW' white-button-black-text pattern seen in screenshots; not cross-checked against every instance of a secondary action across the site.

Could not distinguish a distinct 'card' surface colour from the page background in the inventory; cards appear to sit directly on white with just a border, so this slot was left unassigned rather than guessing.

No feedback/status colours (info, success, warning, danger) showed up with any measurable presence in the inventory; the only non-neutral colour seen is the orange brand accent, which isn't clearly a semantic feedback colour, so these slots were left empty.
No focus-ring colour was present in the measured data.
Monospace font stack appears in the loaded web-fonts list but with no measurable share in the inventory, so size/weight were inferred from the bodySmall pattern rather than observed directly.

Large display line-heights (64px, 52px, 40px, 32px) were estimated from typical display-type ratios since exact matches for these larger sizes weren't present in the measured line-height list; only heading.5 and heading.6 line-heights matched inventory values directly.
Only two corner-radius values (6px, 10px) were observed; no evidence of a larger or fully-rounded radius step, so these were left unassigned.

The /docs pages load Roboto and Source Sans Pro fonts, distinct from the Inter-based marketing site — these appear to be a third-party docs theme rather than part of the core brand system, so they were excluded from the typography tokens.
